How this table will play

Rook / Red 2 anytime

If off, specials must follow suit rules like other cards.

Must trump when void

When you can’t follow suit you must play a trump if you have one.

Bid-only scoring (CrowsNest-style)

If made: score the bid amount only. Set still costs −bid.

Nest counters go to:
Last-trick winner
Bidding team

First lead of the hand:
Player to the left of the bid winner
Bid winner leads
Player to the right of the bid winner

Screw the dealer

Off by default. If everyone passes, the dealer is forced to bid the minimum instead of the hand being redealt.

Misdeal on a counter-less hand

On by default. If any hand has zero point cards (no 5/10/14/one/Rook/Red 1/Red 2), redeal automatically.
